purpose: Change only the threshold split on the exact P0-S3B rows. Keep IU29 scores and locators, the purely-local detector, step-max reducer, population, source grouping, access tier and bootstrap fixed while replacing historical 40/20 calibration/audit thresholding with the current deterministic five-fold source-group cross-fit.

single_changed_factor.to: deterministic five-fold source-group threshold cross-fit on the same audit population

fixed_factors.representation: calibration-only LOCAL_IU29 token risk frozen from S3B
fixed_factors.answer_detector_construction: maximum of the unchanged IU29 token-risk curve
fixed_factors.score_and_locator: reuse exact S3B per-question score and locator
fixed_factors.scorer_copy_grouping: same source-question fold and bootstrap draw carries both scorer copies
fixed_factors.supervision: labels enter only the threshold cross-fit and metrics; no representation or score parameter is refit

crossfit_contract.fit_scope: one scorer model across four subsets
crossfit_contract.assignment: SHA256(group_id) stable ordering then round-robin within stratum
crossfit_contract.decision: argmax step iff maximum score is strictly above threshold else -1

bootstrap_contract: Paired source-question bootstrap on the unchanged 635 groups. A draw carries both scorer copies and both S3B/S4 predictions; family estimates are averaged before the four-family macro contrast.
hard_fail_conditions: any registered S3B artifact dependency runner or registry hash differs
the S3B per-cell metrics do not reconstruct from its frozen decisions within 1e-12
any score locator representation detector reducer row source group or population changes
the same source question is assigned to different folds across scorer copies
any fold lacks one of the five registered fold ids or any threshold training panel lacks a subset or class
any representation or score parameter is refit
interpretation: Audit-only split attribution. Compare S4 directly with S3B for the split effect and with S0 only as a labeled cumulative waterfall position. A zero-crossing interval is inconclusive and not rejection or parity. No method promotion is possible in Phase 0.
